sources.role: world-owned room state and canonical destination validation

semantics.owner: owning movement subsystem supplies traversal completion; RuntimeLivingWorldService commits room ownership
admission: source room equals current world-owned room
requested destination exactly equals persisted admitted destination
owning movement subsystem explicitly reports traversal completion
destination room exists in the generated world
state_changes: NPC RoomId becomes the exact admitted destination
fleeing and destination metadata are cleared
compact movement audit metadata is persisted
semantics.fallback: reject atomically without room mutation when any admission evidence is absent or contradictory

assumptions: the movement subsystem has already validated the traversed exit and restrictions
canonical generated-room existence is necessary but does not itself prove native traversability
runtime_impact: activates save-safe flee room transition after exact external movement completion
world_state_impact: mutates NPC current room and compact world-owned audit metadata
safe_fallback: NPC remains in its current room and retains admitted flee state for explicit retry
